content:
Today is September 1st, and Apple has officially passed the CEO baton from Tim Cook to John Ternus, marking the official start of a new era under Ternus's leadership at the company.

You can see this change on the company's updated leadership page, where Ternus has taken on the CEO title, while Cook has moved to the board section, taking on the new position of Executive Chair.

Outside observers expect Ternus's ascension to herald a shift in company strategy, with Ternus bringing a more product-focused vision compared to Cook's strength in operations management. However, these changes will take time to gradually emerge. His first public-facing task will be to introduce the all-new iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra lineup at the company's September 9th fall event.

Previously, the board members listed on the leadership website only showed their names. With Cook joining this section, Apple has also expanded it by adding profile photos of the members.

Board members include Tim Cook, Arthur Levinson, Wanda Austin, Alex Gorsky, Andrea Jung, Monica Lozano, Ron Sugar, Sue Wagner, as well as John Ternus, who serves on the board in his capacity as CEO.
